summary.headline: Fortune of Parents and Fourth House
summary.text: Chapter XVI explains how to judge the fortune of parents and the significations of the fourth house. It identifies Mercury and Mars as significators of brothers, Venus and the Moon as significators of sisters, and gives day and night methods using the Sun, Saturn, Venus, Moon, the parts of fathers and mothers, their lords, and the fourth sign from the ascendant.
